config.calibration: Refit whitening and innovation using cleaned verified calibration traces only, separately by temperature; retain shrinkage/ridge/minimum-task settings.
config.compute: CPU only; reuse saved states after successful completion of Kimina GPU extraction, without waiting for other models. Comparison report waits for original analysis.
config.failure_policy: Refuted traces and absorbing labels remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Ambiguous, mixed, nonterminal or empty-prefix cases block automatic processing.
config.positional_controls: Reuse frozen offset plan and tested functions on cleaned measurements; Kimina-only additional sensitivity, not an additional confirmatory discovery family.
config.rule: Trim only the terminal suffix of verified traces tagged post_completion, with every source point root_closed_before=true and active_goal_ids=[]; preserve the root-closing step.
config.scope: Structural sensitivity prompted by source audit, specified before new activation results; preserves both earlier analyses.
config.source_preservation: Original generated text, token IDs, whole-proof verdict, observation alignment and all queued jobs are retained.
config.statistics: Reuse existing P1/P2/P3 methods, all three tail estimators, original resampling settings and task split; no significance tuning.
config.thresholds: Recompute P3 thresholds from cleaned calibration values using original q values. Shared transform/threshold calibration remains a limitation.
